what.text: This page follows refugees from Yemen living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5112 Yemeni refugees in Germany, 8.9% of all refugees from Yemen.
Somalia hosts the most Yemeni refugees, followed by the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Yemen in every year from 2008 to 2025, at war level in most of them, with Ansarallah and AQAP among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Yemen in 2015, 2017 and 2020.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 358 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
